sections.label: Singapore growth slowdown
sections.summary: Singapore's growth slowed from 4.7% in 2013 to 2% in 2015, with 2.1% in the first half of 2016 likely to weaken.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: More recently, the UK's vote in June to leave the European Union has dampened and added uncertainties to the global growth outlook.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: So, against this backdrop, growth in the Singapore economy has slowed, from 4.7% in 2013, to 3.3% in 2014 and 2% in 2015.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: While growth came in at 2.1% in the first half of 2016, it is likely to weaken in the second half of this year.

sections.label: MTI growth forecast
sections.summary: MTI expects second-half growth below 2.1% and full-year growth of 1% to 2%, possibly at the lower end.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: On balance, MTI expects growth in the second half of the year to come in lower than the 2.1% achieved in the first half of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: For the full year, MTI's forecast remains at 1% to 2%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: However, given the weakness seen in recent incoming data, such as the NODX data, growth may come in at the lower end of the range.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: As the global economic situation remains fluid, the Government will continue to monitor the situation closely and stands ready to respond in the event of a downturn.

sections.label: SME and marine sector support
sections.summary: Budget 2016 introduced the SME Working Capital Loan scheme and deferred Foreign Worker Levy increases for the marine sector for one year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: Page: 26 For instance, as part of Budget 2016, the Government introduced the SME Working Capital Loan scheme to help address SMEs' cash flow concerns and growth financing needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Trade) (Mr Lim Hng Kiang)
sentences.text: In view of the challenging conditions faced by our companies in the marine and offshore engineering segment, the Government has also deferred the Foreign Worker Levy increases for the marine sector for one year.
